notes: Train times are mostly from bdtrainschedule.com per-train pages published Mar 2025, which match the official Bangladesh Railway Western Region Time Table No. 54 (effective 10 Mar 2025; railway.gov.bd page last updated 12 Mar 2025) wherever the official PDF could be read (Barendra, Rupsha 728, off days for Nilsagar/Simanta/Rupsha/Banglabandha). No newer official timetable was found. trainjatri.com, eticket.railway.gov.bd and the shohoz rail API were blocked by the network proxy; brtc.gov.bd and dailyinfobd.com are robots-disallowed. BRTC: no Joypurhat BRTC depot, route, time or fare was found in readable sources (oursneed.com BRTC counter list, Dec 2024, has no Joypurhat entry; nearest listed is Rajshahi Main Counter 01777832007). No Joypurhat bus departure times and no bus routes other than Dhaka were found. Bus tickets: shohoz.com helpline 16374 (07:00-23:00) per shohoz.com.
